name: Agent-E
description: Agent that automates tasks in a web browser from natural-language commands using DOM distillation and Playwright skills.
whatItDoes: Performs web actions such as searching, filling forms, navigating sites and gathering information on the user's behalf. It serves developers and researchers studying reliable web navigation agents.
howItWorks: Built on the AG2 (AutoGen) conversation framework, it pairs a planning agent with a browser-navigation agent. The navigator calls a library of Playwright-backed skills and receives condensed views of the page DOM so the model can reason about it. Models are set through an env file and a JSON config.

requirements.name: Python with uv
requirements.description: Environment managed by the install script

models: OpenAI and other providers configured in agents_llm_config.json
